description.value:
What more could you want from a weapon spitting homing rounds out of a Smart Link? Poison rounds, obviously. To turn an enemy into Swiss cheese is child's play, but to turn them into a bullet-ridden, steaming pile of liquified remains... that's a job for the Hercules 3AX. 10/10 for style, 2/10 eco-for friendliness.

Category: Super Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Machine Gun • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Battle Rifle

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 90 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Gun 5), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Auto-Compensator, Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load custom Biotoxin-imbued Improved Smart Ammunition (50eb [Costly] per 10) that, when it hits a meat target, the victim must succeed on a DV17 Resist Torture/Drugs Check or else suffer 3d6 HP damage that ignores and does not ablate their armor. This is in addition to the Attack’s regular damage and other effects. This weapon’s Smart Rebuild does not require an Interface Plug/Subdermal Grip to operate. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it expends 3 rounds and deals 1d6 additional damage (6d6). When this weapon reduces a target to 0 HP and kills them, a burst of poison explodes out like a Poison Grenade centered on the victim’s position.

Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Battle Rifle
Pre-installed: Auto-Compensator, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 5), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
